proof.text: Apply exact_mate to the whiskered moduleJAdj and moduleJAdj, with the identity evaluationPullback and evaluationOpen squares. The ordinary unit equation is equality of the same unit followed by an identity. Both derived units satisfy exactAdj_unit, so exact localization gives the equation with the specified evalG and evalJ.

title: Evaluation preserves the open adjunction unit
statement: For every open immersion f and index n, evaluation carries the strict open adjunction unit through evalG and evalJ as the displayed component equation.

lean.statement: theorem evaluation_open_unit (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] (n : ℕ) (M : Derived B U) : (ev B U n).map ((jAdj B f).unit.app M) ≫ (evalG B f n).hom.app ((J B f).obj M) = (dJAdj B f).unit.app ((ev B U n).obj M) ≫ (g B f).map ((evalJ B f n).inv.app M)
